clue.text: Record is held by district commissioner

indicators.note: held by says the word is sits inside the abbreviation that follows

parts.note: DC is the standard abbreviation for district commissioner
taken as written

explanation.surface: An official is said to have custody of some document.
explanation.definitionFit: A gramophone record is a flat vinyl platter, so the two words name the same object.

clue.text: Bet the meat's been chopped

definitions.meaning: to dice is to gamble with dice, so 'bet' is the past tense of that sense
meat cut into small cubes has been cut this way

explanation.surface: Someone wagers that the butcher has already cut up the meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are past forms of one verb: gambling with dice, and cutting food into cubes.

clue.text: Physical energy found in NCO

indicators.note: found in says the energy symbol is placed inside the rank that follows

parts.note: a corporal is a non-commissioned officer, an NCO
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A sergeant-type soldier is noted for sheer physical vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean bodily, relating to the material body rather than the spirit.

clue.text: Some prisoners inevitably offend

indicators.note: Some means only part of the following words is taken, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Jailbirds are bound to break the law again.
explanation.definitionFit: To sin is to transgress, to commit a wrong, which is to offend.

clue.text: He makes a casserole with skill

parts.note: a stew is a slow-cooked casserole dish
art is skill, as in the art of cooking

explanation.surface: A man is a dab hand at slow-cooked dishes.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'He': the answer is a man's name, so any male name could stand behind the pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: Stewart is a male forename, so a man so named can be referred to by the pronoun.

clue.text: Absence of this feature results in total harmony

definitions.text: Absence of this feature results in total harmony

parts.words: Absence of this feature results in total harmony
parts.note: an idiom for a peaceful relationship, read as a grid with no clue running in one direction, playing on the puzzle itself

explanation.surface: A couple whose relationship is free of quarrels lives in perfect accord.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes people who never quarrel, and literally names a puzzle direction left out.

clue.text: Bound to be in season

definitions.meaning: a bound is a leap or jump
one of the four seasons, the one after winter

explanation.surface: Something is certain to be available at this time of year.
explanation.definitionFit: A leap and the vernal season share one word, so both senses are covered.

clue.text: Tries hard to produce melodies

explanation.surface: A composer labours to come up with tunes.
explanation.definitionFit: Exertion and passages of music share the same plural noun and verb form.

clue.text: One about to settle in the country

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
re means about or concerning
to land is to settle or come to rest, as a bird does

explanation.surface: Someone is on the point of making a home abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland is a nation in north-west Europe, an example of a country.

clue.text: The duck is of outstanding excellence, I hear

parts.note: golden means excellent, as in a golden opportunity

indicators.note: I hear says the letter before it is heard, so its sound is written as the word for the organ of sight

parts.note: the pronoun is spoken

explanation.surface: Someone claims a particular duck is supremely fine.
explanation.definitionFit: The goldeneye is a diving duck of northern waters, a species of wildfowl.

clue.text: Care to bring a prosecution?

definitions.meaning: a person in your ... is in your care
to accuse them formally of a crime

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether you would like to take a case to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Custody and a formal accusation share one word, covering both senses.

clue.text: OK? No, in fine fettle

definitions.meaning: a reluctant agreement, all right then

explanation.surface: Asked if they are merely all right, someone replies they are actually in great shape.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase works both as a grudging yes and as a description of excellent health.

clue.text: Suave socialite in seventh heaven

parts.note: a deb, a debutante, is a young woman entering high society
walking on air means blissfully happy, so on air is in seventh heaven

explanation.surface: A smooth society girl is utterly delighted.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair describes a man who is charming, confident and stylish, a synonym of smooth.

clue.text: Local gets fed up, as is natural

parts.note: a local is a pub, here an inn
ate up means consumed, so fed up gives the past tense of eat

explanation.surface: A pub regular becomes annoyed, as you might expect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fed up' looks like annoyed but is a meal: to feed up is to eat, giving the past tense. A local in Britain is your neighbourhood pub.
explanation.definitionFit: An innate quality is inborn, present from birth, so it is natural to someone.

clue.text: As grand as a sovereign

parts.note: an adjective meaning stately, read as befitting a monarch addressed as Her or His Majesty

explanation.surface: Something is as magnificent as a reigning monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means stately and imposing, and derives from the title used for a reigning monarch.

clue.text: Scheme whereby friend retains a feature

indicators.note: retains says the word for a friend keeps the other pieces held inside it

parts.note: a mate is a friend
the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: A pal holds on to one notable quality as part of some plan.
explanation.definitionFit: To machinate is to plot or devise an intrigue, so it is a verb meaning to plot.

clue.text: Army officer expected to calm down

parts.note: a sub is short for a subaltern, a junior army officer
due means expected, as in a train due at noon

explanation.surface: A junior officer is supposed to settle the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: To subdue is to quieten or bring under control, which is to calm something down.

clue.text: She takes steps to advance her career

definitions.text: She takes steps to advance her career

parts.words: She takes steps to advance her career
parts.note: literally a dancer whose career is built on dance steps, posing as an ambitious professional

explanation.surface: An ambitious woman makes moves to get on in her profession.
explanation.definitionFit: A classical female dancer literally takes dance steps as her work.

clue.text: Military summons holds many a drawback

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, which is many

indicators.note: back says the word for draw is turned round and read the other way

parts.note: to pull is to draw, as a cart

explanation.surface: Conscription papers bring plenty of disadvantages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawback' looks like one word meaning a disadvantage, but it splits: 'draw' is the piece and 'back' turns it round, giving LLUP.
explanation.definitionFit: A call-up is an official order to report for military service, a summons to the forces.

clue.text: Buddy upset aunt terribly. How absurd!

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word for buddy is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: a pal is a buddy

indicators.note: terribly says the letters of the next word are badly jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's friend has really offended their aunt, to general disbelief.
explanation.walkthrough: Laputa is the flying island in Gulliver's Travels whose scholars pursue absurd schemes.
explanation.definitionFit: Laputan, from Swift's island of impractical thinkers, means visionary and preposterous, a literary synonym.

clue.text: Place to find the colliery manager?

definitions.text: Place to find the colliery manager?

parts.words: Place to find the colliery manager?
parts.note: the top of a mine shaft, read whimsically as the boss of the mine

explanation.surface: Someone asks where the boss of a coal mine can be found.
explanation.definitionFit: The area at the top of a mine shaft would literally be called the head of the pit.

clue.text: The dying embers of a former passion

definitions.text: The dying embers of a former passion

parts.words: The dying embers of a former passion
parts.note: an ex-lover, pictured as a fire that once burned and is now just glowing

explanation.surface: A love affair has burned down to its last glow.
explanation.definitionFit: A former sweetheart is called by the fire image, a blaze from years past.

clue.text: Imagined myself engulfed by terror

indicators.note: engulfed by says the word for myself is swallowed inside the word for terror

parts.note: dread is great fear, terror
me stands for the speaker, myself

explanation.surface: Someone fancied they were overwhelmed by fear.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamed means pictured in the mind or fancied, a synonym of imagined.

clue.text: I am left to bring in the goods

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone says it falls to them to fetch in the merchandise.
explanation.definitionFit: To import is to bring merchandise into a country from abroad.

clue.text: Wicked witch meaning to reform?

definitions.meaning: respaced as two words, ..., meaning to give up wrongdoing

explanation.surface: A wicked witch apparently intends to mend her ways.
explanation.walkthrough: Split differently the letters read SHED EVIL, to cast off wickedness, which is what reforming means; the question mark flags the respacing.
explanation.definitionFit: A she-devil is a cruel, malevolent woman, much like a wicked witch.

clue.text: Lavish ship for a ruler?

definitions.meaning: an ocean-going passenger vessel, often luxurious
something that draws lines, as a ruler does

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a luxury vessel would suit a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocean steamer and a tool for drawing straight lines share the one word.

clue.text: Another novel about one unworthy character

indicators.note: about says the jumbled letters go round the numeral for one
novel means new, so the letters of the preceding word are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A fresh book features a disreputable protagonist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book in the surface but signals the anagram of ANOTHER, which then goes about I.
explanation.definitionFit: An antihero is a central figure lacking conventional heroic virtues, a flawed protagonist.

clue.text: People without assistance require her

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means the word for people surrounds the word for help

parts.note: men are people
aid is assistance

explanation.surface: Folk who cannot cope alone are said to need some woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but in its old sense it means outside; 'her' as a definition is fair because any woman's word could stand behind the pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: A maiden is a young unmarried woman, someone the pronoun could refer to.

clue.text: Need an arrangement for 9

indicators.note: an arrangement of letters puts the preceding words into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone requires a layout for nine items.
explanation.definitionFit: An ennead is a group or set of nine, from the Greek for that number.

clue.text: However viewed, it's a failure

indicators.note: however viewed says the word reads the same from either end, forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something is a flop whichever way you look at it.
explanation.definitionFit: A dud is something that does not work, such as a shell that fails to explode.

clue.text: A container that isn't properly shut

definitions.note: the definition is a verb phrase standing for an adjective: a door that isn't properly shut is slightly open

parts.note: a jar is a container

explanation.surface: A pot whose lid has not been closed properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Ajar means slightly open, describing a door left not fully closed.
